poc_plan: Objective: Validate Dedicated pool sizing for 99th percentile throughput and p95 latency SLOs for reranking in production-like conditions.
Phase 1 - Baseline run: single-model full-capacity run to measure tokens/s per GPU and cold-start behavior (2h)
Phase 2 - Load sweep: incremental RPS from 50 to 4,000 concurrent requests to map latency vs concurrency (scripts use realistic prompt corpus)
Phase 3 - 48h soak: run production-mix (60% reranking, 30% chat, 10% batch-embeds) to measure steady-state utilization, mem pressure, gradual cache warmup
Phase 4 - Fault injection: simulate node preemption and model fallback to verify graceful degradation and routing policies
Phase 5 - Cost/ops: measure effective cost-per-1M tokens across batching, cache hit-rates, and model-quantization tradeoffs
Metrics collected: p50/p95/p99 latency (token and request), throughput (tokens/sec), GPU util %, tail GC/latency events, KV cache hit rate, error rate
technical_requirements: Latency SLO target: p95 < 120ms for reranking requests (end-to-end), p99 < 300ms desirable
Throughput target: sustain 2M tokens/hour for reranking flow with headroom for +30% burst
Reserved GPU capacity: initial recommendation 8 x A100-eq (pool) with autoscale +1 node burst policy
Network: VPC peering to customer network, private egress for EU data, 10Gbps egress baseline
Security: Customer-managed KMS for key wrapping, SAML-based SSO for console access, audit logs delivered to their SIEM
Data residency: EU/NA segmentation for region-specific traffic routing
acceptance_criteria: 48h soak run completes with p95 latency <= 120ms for 95% of windows
No more than 0.1% request errors attributable to RT timeouts or OOM during soak
Observed GPU utilization stable between 60-85% (indicates right-sizing) without sustained queuing
KV/prefix cache achieves >= 40% hit-rate for reranking workloads after warmup
SE sign-off on failover tests: model fallback latency increase <= 2x baseline and no request loss
decision_criteria: If acceptance criteria met, propose annual Dedicated contract with 10-15% discount for 12-month commit
If soak shows under-utilization, propose smaller pool + autoscale + cost-optimization plan via Redwood Optimize
If soak shows tail latency issues > target, escalate to runtime optimization team for kernel tuning and quantization tests
